Student Finances
Funding at Western
Western University offers various funding opportunities for thesis-based MSc and PhD students in the Department of Computer Science. Funding varies depending on the program and student status (domestic or international). Below is a detailed overview.
Funding Summary by Program Type
Program Type
Domestic Students
International Students
MSc – Thesis-Based
Minimum funding support typically includes GTA, WGRS, and supervisor support. Covers tuition and provides a modest living stipend.
Similar structure, but students are responsible for a portion of international tuition fees. Additional external funding may be needed.
PhD
Fully funded through a combination of GTA, WGRS, and supervisor support.
Similar funding model as domestic.
MSc – Course-Based
No funding provided. Students must be fully self-funded.
No funding provided. Students must be fully self-funded, including all tuition and living costs.
Typical Funding Sources (Thesis-Based Students)
Source
Description
Graduate Teaching Assistantship (GTA)
Monthly Paid position assisting with undergraduate courses (up to 10 hours/week in Fall and Winter).
Western Graduate Research Scholarship (WGRS)
Institutional funding support awarded to thesis-based students.
Supervisor Funding
Support from research grants—amounts vary depending on the supervisor and project.
External Scholarships
Includes OGS, NSERC, and international awards. Students are encouraged to apply where eligible.
Summer Term Funding
Student Type
Summer Term Support
Thesis-Based (MSc/PhD)
May receive supervisor funding (GTA not typically available in summer). Must maintain full-time status.
Course-Based
No departmental funding available. Summer tuition still applies as the program is continuous.

** MSc students are guaranteed funding for 5 terms (if all requirements are being met)
** PhD students are guaranteed funding for 4 years (if all requirements are being met)
